typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		parentMetricID as string,
		childMetricID as string,
		metricID as integer,
		metricOwner as string,
		Metric_Date as string,
		{Period Counter Week} as double,
		{Period Counter Month} as double,
		{Period Counter Quarter} as double,
		Year as double,
		Manager as string,
		Asset_Class as string,
		Type as string,
		Non_Electronic_PC as decimal(18,2),
		Non_Electronic_QTY as integer,
		Electronic_PC as decimal(18,2),
		Electronic_QTY as integer,
		Metric_Calc as decimal(11,4),
		Metric_Threshold as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Manager} = Manager,
		{Copy of Asset_Class} = Asset_Class,
		{Copy of Type} = Type) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Period_Counter_Week as integer,
		Metric_Calc as integer,
		Electronic_QTY as integer,
		Non_Electronic_QTY as integer,
		Non_Electronic_PC as integer,
		Manager as string,
		metricOwner as string,
		Type as string,
		childMetricID as integer,
		metricID as integer,
		Year as integer,
		Metric_Threshold as string,
		Metric_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Period_Counter_Quarter as integer,
		parentMetricID as integer,
		Period_Counter_Month as integer,
		Electronic_PC as integer,
		Asset_Class as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Period_Counter_Week = {Period Counter Week},
		Metric_Calc,
		Electronic_QTY,
		Non_Electronic_QTY,
		Non_Electronic_PC,
		Manager = {Copy of Manager},
		metricOwner,
		Type = {Copy of Type},
		childMetricID,
		metricID,
		Year,
		Metric_Threshold,
		Metric_Date,
		Period_Counter_Quarter = {Period Counter Quarter},
		parentMetricID,
		Period_Counter_Month = {Period Counter Month},
		Electronic_PC,
		Asset_Class = {Copy of Asset_Class}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
